AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#367 @ 2699b4b10f4a5370a8d44121f7b8c18331a712b0 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Job: AUD-SOL-SCH3-122, agent 122. Independent B closure and changed-lines review. A/B/C = 0/0/0.

**B-367-1 CLOSED. Normal-user story:** A new client choosing a regular check-in from the welcome fallback now sees that check-in's title and books it without falsely completing the welcome-call tutorial ([K3 fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/367#issuecomment-6006086428)).

`CalendarBookScreen.tsx:125,171,284,304` now gates welcome headings/completion on the selected welcome type, not the route flag alone; ordinary fallback booking and genuine welcome booking remain available ([K3 diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/367/files)). The two [previously failing Sol assertions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/367#issuecomment-6005711262) are present at `calendarScreens.test.tsx:631–663`, and the [targeted CI lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37391748215) passed all 78 tests plus typecheck, including genuine-welcome coverage; its product tree equals this exact head, with only CI-wrapper files added.

Prior C-367-1 is also closed: `calendarUi.tsx:27–28` names an expired request, and `CalendarSessionScreen.tsx:226–234` offers “Pick another time” for the same coach/type ([K3 diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/367/files)).

The pre-fix K3 patch is unchanged across its lower-piece restack; read the `ClientNavigator.tsx` main union and all five fix files, with no unrelated expansion or normal-use regression found in the [fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/367#issuecomment-6006086428).

Exact-head [Typecheck, lint, test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37392190307/job/112039625849) is green. Land the complete train with required main-tree analyses; do not release [K2's dependent tutorial wiring](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/366#issuecomment-6005616710) alone.

No local tests/builds, pushes, merges, or investigation of excluded edge cases.
